question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'launched'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence '** *The ship, originally named Polaris, was built at Framnæs shipyard and (3) ______ in 1912 from Sandefjord in Norway.*** ' requires an **appropriate word** from the given options for the **blank number 3.**
 
• **Let us explore the given options:**
 
 
• **Released means **to allow somebody/something to be free.(मुक्त करना)
 
• **Launched means **to send a ship into the water or a spacecraft into the sky.(जहाज़ को पानी में उतारना)
 
• **Started means **to begin at one point and then move to another in distance or range.
 
• **Recovered means **to become well again after you have been ill.(बीमारी के बाद स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य लाभ करना).
 
 
 
• Therefore, from the given meaning of the given options, it is obvious that the **ship** was **launched into the water in 1912 **from Sandefjord in Norway.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

45:T61e,

The correct answer is** 'was'**.
